### CNH to announce 2026 Q3 results on November 9


October 19, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s205.q4cdn.com/962820841/files/doc_news/CNH-to-announce-2026-Q3-results-on-November-9-2026.pdf)


**Basildon, UK — October 19, 2026 — CNH (NYSE: CNH)** will release its financial results for the Third Quarter of 2026 on Monday, November 9, 2026.


A live listen-only webcast of the financial results conference call will begin at 9:00 a.m. ET on the same day here:[https://events.q4inc.com/attendee/972547137](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=dvqGeKZyPkJiucQEcRN11Ay_GwKJBW9xcY-WrlrJD5cTjrLJiiVW9gwbCQt8QCxD7FgLPC0hZ0zhOd468X2WNyA9goxQUziA7Uo1xgxRz8xsP2glOHFdWh1YA65ms2lJfWGQL2mJgQtGanNakYuVId3QZbfdyR0LbvUa-LQAjeI=)


For those unable to participate in the live session, a replay will remain archived in the Investor Relations section of the corporate website ([www.cnh.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=1fhWprgvf0kGar6zrh7ctFJAHG8krGUrLe5EuC2obU0_UIn4Ox5pnBBwZRiXsKIGgT2fDCww_DO_YrTvzcFQ5A==) ) for 12 months.


**Dial-in details:**


Those interested in participating in the Q&A session should connect via telephone at least 10 minutes prior to the start of the event. Telephone participants are required to register in advance via the following link:[https://events.q4inc.com/analyst/972547137?pwd=Hsf7bzsZ](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=dvqGeKZyPkJiucQEcRN11Ay_GwKJBW9xcY-WrlrJD5eEJ47zYoApDMy6qU57yKvzHyRiN2lKA6wHVwW6PkTs1TQSPt2EsqdnDnFjSF9c7cnRs9mIFGxypZ4r8N8SmY3_qZHPz-uBfMgmL9JllhLYp7KA5xD6IgNp8IPSfqM-qlOjD3zWlEilDhcgSF7m_rGE)


After registration, participants will receive dial‑in instructions by email, including:


- the conference call dial‑in number


- the meeting ID (972547137)


- a unique passcode to access the call


***


**About CNH**


CNH (NYSE: CNH) serves and advances the people who feed and build a growing world.


We are an iron-and-tech company, engineering intelligence, automation, and precision into the machines that move the global economy. Our equipment operates in more than 160 markets, supported by a global team of more than 34,000 people, including engineers, technologists, and industry experts.


Our brands - Case IH, New Holland, and STEYR in agriculture; CASE Construction Equipment and New Holland Construction in building - are backed by CNH Capital and complemented by a portfolio of technology and regional brands that together generated $18.1B in revenue in 2025.


Building on a legacy of innovation dating back to 1842, CNH has achieved milestones including the first mass-produced tractor, the first twin-rotor combine, and the first factory-integrated precision farming system.


Today, we are engineering autonomous and predictive machines that will shape the future of food and infrastructure.
